newsitem.title: USA: CAI Wireless to start access service.
newsitem.headline: CAI Wireless to start access service.

text.p: CAI Wireless Systems Inc said on Monday it plans commercial rollout of its high-speed wireless Internet access service as early as the first quarter of 1997.
The company said it would conduct a market trial of the service in Rochester by the end of September.
CAI, which will use General Instrument Corp cable modems and network equipment, said it expects its access network to transmit data at raw speeds of 27 megabits per second.
The market trial will use residential and business users and is expected to last about three months, the company said.
